verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents programmatic Person and Business Applications for account opening and a KYC guide covering KYC/KYB through integration of a bank-approved third-party vendor, plus Incremental KYC without opening an account. Verification itself runs through an external vendor rather than being shown as native, and the pack gives no detail on how documents, screening or statuses are handled. Missing for 10: documented document-collection endpoints, watchlist/sanctions screening, explicitly modeled application states/status lifecycle, native (non-vendor) verification depth, independent corroboration.
